\[ 500 \, \text{mg/L} \times 10 \, \text{L} = 5000 \, \text{mg} = 5 \, \text{g} \]

\[ \text{水的体积} = 10,000 \, \text{mL} - 83 \, \text{mL} = 9917 \, \text{mL} \]

因此，正确答案是 A. 83mL和9917mL。
